decision: Use bounded fresh-process census batches for exhaustive diagnostic coverage; do not require one long-lived diagnostic process.

resources.scope: Simulator host protection; not device RAM or Lua-heap acceptance

scope_limits: Fresh processes reset program/content caches; every batch boundary remains explicit.
Per-case cold/warm labels describe actual target Zone residency only, not OS/content cache normalization.
A batch failure stops scheduling; no automatic failure retry or gap waiver.
Completing all rows is not all transitions measured, hardware timing or natural traversal.
Continuous100+door/30+map/20battle device traversal and exact short safety remain separate mandatory gates.
No production gameplay fix or long-session memory claim is established.
